description: Source file implementing classes and methods for F1-AP DU bearer handling, including SDU processing, PDCP SN management, and RRC delivery reports within the F1 interface of a 5G network.

classes.name: f1c_srb0_du_bearer
classes.description: Handles SDU processing and RRC message transfer for SRB0 in F1 interface.

classes.name: f1c_other_srb_du_bearer
classes.description: Manages SDU processing, PDCP SN tracking, and delivery reports for other SRBs in F1 interface.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Processes incoming SDU chain, constructs F1AP message, and notifies upper layers.

methods.name: handle_transmit_notification
methods.description: Handles transmission notification; not applicable for SRB0.

methods.name: handle_delivery_notification
methods.description: Handles delivery notification; not applicable for SRB0.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Forwards PDU to lower layers after switching to UE execution context.

methods.name: handle_pdu_and_await_delivery
methods.description: Handles PDU and waits for delivery acknowledgment or timeout.

methods.name: handle_pdu_and_await_transmission
methods.description: Handles PDU and waits for transmission acknowledgment or timeout.

methods.name: handle_notification
methods.description: Updates PDCP SN status and triggers pending events based on highest SN.

methods.name: wait_for_notification
methods.description: Returns an awaitable event for PDCP SN notification or timeout.

methods.name: handle_rrc_delivery_report
methods.description: Constructs and sends RRC delivery report message to the gNB-CU.
